verses.text: My son, pay attention to my wisdom. Turn your ear to my understanding,
lines: My son, pay attention to my wisdom.
Turn your ear to my understanding,

verses.text: that you may maintain discretion, that your lips may preserve knowledge.
lines: that you may maintain discretion,
that your lips may preserve knowledge.

verses.text: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil,
lines: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey.
Her mouth is smoother than oil,

verses.text: but in the end she is as bitter as wormwood, and as sharp as a two-edged sword.
lines: but in the end she is as bitter as wormwood,
and as sharp as a two-edged sword.

verses.text: Her feet go down to death. Her steps lead straight to Sheol.
lines: Her feet go down to death.
Her steps lead straight to Sheol.

verses.text: She gives no thought to the way of life. Her ways are crooked, and she doesn’t know it.
lines: She gives no thought to the way of life.
Her ways are crooked, and she doesn’t know it.

verses.text: Now therefore, my sons, listen to me. Don’t depart from the words of my mouth.
lines: Now therefore, my sons, listen to me.
Don’t depart from the words of my mouth.

verses.text: Remove your way far from her. Don’t come near the door of her house,
lines: Remove your way far from her.
Don’t come near the door of her house,

verses.text: lest you give your honor to others, and your years to the cruel one;
lines: lest you give your honor to others,
and your years to the cruel one;

verses.text: lest strangers feast on your wealth, and your labors enrich another man’s house.
lines: lest strangers feast on your wealth,
and your labors enrich another man’s house.

verses.text: You will groan at your latter end, when your flesh and your body are consumed,
lines: You will groan at your latter end,
when your flesh and your body are consumed,

verses.text: and say, “How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;
lines: and say, “How I have hated instruction,
and my heart despised reproof;

verses.text: neither have I obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor turned my ear to those who instructed me!
lines: neither have I obeyed the voice of my teachers,
nor turned my ear to those who instructed me!

verses.text: I have come to the brink of utter ruin, among the gathered assembly.”
lines: I have come to the brink of utter ruin,
among the gathered assembly.”

verses.text: Drink water out of your own cistern, running water out of your own well.
lines: Drink water out of your own cistern,
running water out of your own well.

verses.text: Should your springs overflow in the streets, streams of water in the public squares?
lines: Should your springs overflow in the streets,
streams of water in the public squares?

verses.text: Let them be for yourself alone, not for strangers with you.
lines: Let them be for yourself alone,
not for strangers with you.

verses.text: Let your spring be blessed. Rejoice in the wife of your youth.
lines: Let your spring be blessed.
Rejoice in the wife of your youth.

verses.text: A loving doe and a graceful deer— let her breasts satisfy you at all times. Be captivated always with her love.
lines: A loving doe and a graceful deer—
let her breasts satisfy you at all times.
Be captivated always with her love.

verses.text: For why should you, my son, be captivated with an adulteress? Why embrace the bosom of another?
lines: For why should you, my son, be captivated with an adulteress?
Why embrace the bosom of another?

verses.text: For the ways of man are before Yahweh’s eyes. He examines all his paths.
lines: For the ways of man are before Yahweh’s eyes.
He examines all his paths.

verses.text: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.
lines: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him.
The cords of his sin hold him firmly.

verses.text: He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray.
lines: He will die for lack of instruction.
In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray.
